message.content:
`docker start` is used to start **containers**, not the Docker engine itself.  
If you want to start the Docker service (so you can then run `docker start` on containers), you can do it from PowerShell or CMD:

```powershell
# PowerShell (run as Administrator)
Start-Service -Name com.docker.service
```

or

```cmd
:: CMD (run as Administrator)
net start com.docker.service
```

Once the Docker service is running, you can start a specific container with:

```bash
docker start <container_name>
```

Replace `<container_name>` with the actual name or ID of the container you wish to start.
